items.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued October 21 at 3:01AM AKDT until October 21 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 5 to 11
inches expected.

* WHERE...Upper Chena River Valley, White Mountains and High Terrain
South of the Yukon River, and Yukon Flats.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Gusty winds could lead to
areas of blowing snow which could reduce visibility below one half
mile at times.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snowfall rates will diminish through
Wednesday.
items.areas: Yukon Flats; White Mountains and High Terrain South of the Yukon River; Upper Chena River Valley
items.instruction:
If you must travel, keep an extra flashlight, food, and water in your
vehicle in case of an emergency. Visit 511.alaska.gov or call 5 1 1
for the latest road conditions.
